newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan October gold imports fall 31.04 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan October gold imports fall 31.04 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Taiwan's imports of gold bars, coins and plate fell 31.04 percent to 6.064 tonnes in October from 8.794 tonnes a year earlier, the Finance Ministry said on Thursday.
The imports were below September's 7.369 tonnes.

Gold traders attributed the fall in imports to seasonal adjustments and the return to a slower market after a period of tension with China in March that had investors pouring their local money into the safe havens of gold and U.S. dollars.
Gold imports hit a record 25.238 tonnes in March, up 162.4 percent from March 1995.
The gold stock accumulated since March would be slowly consumed by the end of 1996, gold traders said. Imports would return to normal in 1997, they added.
The ministry said Taiwan's gold exports in October remained small at 0.329 tonnes, up from 0.255 tonnes in October 1995.
